verdicts.title: A Constructive Proof of Cut Elimination for a System of Full Second Order Logic
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper we present a constructive proof of cut elimination for a system of full second order logic with the structural rules absorbed and using sets instead of sequences. The standard problem of the cutrank growth is avoided by using a new parameter for the induction, the cutweight. This technique can also be applied to first order logic.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract addresses cut elimination in second-order logic via a 'cutweight' induction parameter, which has no interaction with DP elimination on 3-regular Tseitin formulas or the growth exponent of Φ(π). It shares no specific claim with the conjecture.
